description: Figure 8 illustrates the relative performance change across different layer groups of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model under Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning with SnapKV, using a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis categorizes the model into five layer groups: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change,” is scaled from -25% to +5% in 5% increments, indicating the percentage deviation from baseline performance. Five distinct lines represent different quantization and token configurations: LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit (orange, solid line with circle markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit (red, solid line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit (light blue, solid line with circle markers), RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit (dark blue, solid line with square markers), and Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit (gray, dashed line). All lines start near 0% relative change in Layer1-4, then dip sharply in Layer5-12 and Layer13-20, with the RULER4k 1×tokens,16-bit line reaching approximately -25% at Layer13-20. Performance recovers in Layer21-28 and Layer29-32, with most lines returning close to or slightly above 0% by the final layer group. The baseline remains flat at 0% across all layers.
